name: pension_campaign_v1
evidence_notes: SOXX observations before 2021-06-21 carry the disclosed index-break label.
Current live Korean ETF history is too short for an observed 20-year test.

Ratios value each account as if closed at the cohort end with the non-pension tax (credit clawed back); pension-receipt values are a bracket that assumes deferral to eligibility and no further return; see years_to_draw_at_threshold.
USD/KRW on Korean-holiday sessions comes from FRED DEXKOUS (NY-noon buying rate) instead of the ECOS base rate; see fx_provenance for count and same-day basis.

Cohorts whose baseline after-tax wealth is zero (no contribution was made, for example a profile with no usable tax credit) have no defined paired ratio and are excluded from ratio, rate, and drawdown statistics; see the undefined column.

Household view compares the same available cash: pension (credit-optimal contributions, valued at exit) plus a general account holding leftover cash and credit refunds, versus all cash in a general account holding the same US-listed ETFs under Korean overseas-equity tax with year-end gain harvesting.
